Priya (CS): FYI Caledonia finished peering and shared their transit CIDR (10.248.0.0/16). Can we run a quick preflight before tomorrow's dry-run? They also asked about extended audit retention and SIEM costs.

Ethan (Solutions): Send the egress IPs and whether they have TLS inspection on the path. I want to validate NAT/SNAT behavior.

Priya (CS): Egress: 34.201.11.10, 34.201.11.11. Staging bypasses TLS inspection; prod may inspect. No transparent proxy for service certs.

Leo (Infra): If inspection is present we need health-check bypass and KMS passthrough. Also confirm firewall allows outbound to kms.us-east-1.amazonaws.com:443 and S3 for model artifacts.

Nina (Security): Reviewed their KMS policy draft. It contains wildcard principals and broad CreateGrant. We recommended narrowing to the deploy role ARN and scoping kms:ViaService to ec2.us-east-1.amazonaws.com. Also asked for key rotation schedule and enabling KMS data event logging.

KMS-bot: preflight run -> key status: ENABLED; policy checks: wildcard principal detected (WARN), CreateGrant unrestricted (WARN). Recommend policy tighten.

Ethan (Solutions): For audit verification propose this dry-run test: 1) PutObject to S3 with fixed key 2) Short model init call -> /v1/models/ping 3) small download. That should generate CloudTrail + VPC flow entries we can trace to their SIEM. I'll post a script.

Priya (CS): Dry-run scheduled 09:00 PT tomorrow. Can Leo and Nina join for infra/security signoff? I'll ask Caledonia for: 1) firewall rule confirmation to KMS endpoint 2) IAM role ARN for Redwood deployer 3) read access to the test CloudTrail logs. Also flagging renewal risk: they asked for 5yr audit retention — we'll surface cost tradeoffs.

Leo (Infra): Network checklist for call: route propagation for 10.248.0.0/16, NAT SNAT mapping to 34.201.11.10/11, FW egress to KMS + S3, TLS inspection bypass for probes, logging agent egress allowed.

Nina (Security): I'll prepare a tightened policy snippet and minimal IAM role permissions (kms:Decrypt, kms:GenerateDataKey). If they can't meet rotation/monitoring expectations we escalate to renewal bucket.

Priya (CS): Great — I'll update the invite and ping their PM. KMS-bot: re-run preflight 30m before call. :thumbsup:
